settings.title: Order confirmed
settings.description: Your deck specifications are finalized and sent to production.

settings.title: Materials selected
settings.description: Your materials are selected and quality checked.

settings.title: Components in production
settings.description: Your deck is taking shape. Every component is now in production.

settings.title: Hardware preparation
settings.description: Your blocks, brackets and fasteners are being prepared for your kit.

settings.main_heading: Your deck is now in production.
settings.subheading: Every A-DIY deck is made just for you, nothing sits in a warehouse.
settings.card_note: We'll email you as soon as your deck moves to the next step.

settings.title: Your deck comes together
settings.description: We assemble the complete frame to make sure every component fits as intended.

settings.title: Everything lines up
settings.description: We check the deck for square, level and proper alignment.

settings.title: Every connection is checked
settings.description: Brackets and connections are secured and the assembled deck is tested for stability.

settings.main_heading: It should just fit. So we make sure it does.
settings.subheading: Your deck is assembled at our factory first, so every connection is checked before it reaches you.
settings.checklist_subtext: Nothing leaves here until all four pass.

settings.title: Track it live
settings.description: Follow your shipment and delivery progress from the moment it leaves our facility.

settings.title: The carrier will call you
settings.description: Once your deck reaches the local terminal, the delivery team will contact you to schedule a delivery time. They should arrive with the equipment needed to unload your order. If they don't, do not arrange equipment yourself. Contact us and we'll coordinate a safe delivery.

settings.title: Delivered curbside
settings.description: Your deck will be delivered to the curb or driveway at your property.

settings.title: Check everything within 14 days
settings.description: Once delivered, please make sure all parts arrived safely and nothing is missing. If you need more than 14 days to inspect your order, just let our team know.

settings.heading: Getting your deck ready to ship.
settings.subheading: We're packing and securing everything for its trip to you.
settings.alert_badge_text: Last chance · leaves in a few days
settings.alert_title: Last chance to add steps & railings.
settings.alert_text_1: Your deck is being packed for shipment. This is the final point where we can add steps or railings and send everything together at no additional shipping cost.
settings.alert_text_2: Once your deck is picked up, anything added later will need to ship separately with a separate delivery charge.
settings.alert_highlight_note: This is the last step where adding is free. After pickup it's a separate delivery, with its own shipping charge.
